name: Operator Update Coverage Bench

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: native release build, criterion benches (macOS arm64)
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Operator Update Coverage Bench Hypothesis

### Hypothesis

The per-update O(n) hotspots found so far (filter index, sort positions, bridge reinsert) were invisible until a steady-state bench measured them. A second bench measuring one source write into a 10k-row pipeline for further operators (cache group, inner/left join, transform_many, inline transform, sum/count aggregates, list group, list transform_many, list distinct_values, cache filter+sort+bind) will expose the remaining ones.

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** measurement enablement (new bench target only).
**Allowed changes:** `crates/benches/operator_updates.rs`, its `[[bench]]` entry.
**Forbidden in this experiment:** any production source change.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

`cargo bench --bench operator_updates -- --save-baseline base`. Pass: compiles, clippy/fmt clean, stable medians.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

A per-update baseline for ten more operators; points far above ~1 us at 10k rows are O(n) candidates.
